name: mpyricalspace-build-status
description: Shows whether individual compiled wrappers load, without importing mpyricalspace or starting builds.

mpyricalspace.pythonPath.description: Python executable for isolated wrapper checks. Empty uses the Python extension selection, falling back to python3.

mpyricalspace.decorateBadges.description: Show a check / cross badge on the folder (the colour is applied regardless).

mpyricalspace.buildDirectory.description: Existing Meson build directory, absolute or relative to the source workspace. Select explicitly if several builds exist.

mpyricalspace.packageDirectory.description: Directory containing installed wrapper files. Overrides Meson discovery; useful for nonstandard installations.

mpyricalspace.probeTimeout.description: Maximum seconds per isolated probe. A timeout never triggers a build or repair.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Loading native wrappers requires a trusted workspace.
